- Explore: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

attachment.content:
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). First looks for a project skill that already covers launching the app; otherwise falls back to built-in patterns per project type (CLI, server, TUI, Electron, browser-driven, library).
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a GitHub pull request; for your working diff use /code-review
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

33		ThumbnailCacheFolder = ".thumbnail_cache"
34

36		MotionCacheFolder = ".motion_cache"
37	
38		// thumbnailMaxSize is the maximum dimension (width or height) for thumbnails.
39		thumbnailMaxSize = 600
40	
41		// thumbnailMetadataProbeSize is the maximum number of original image bytes inspected
42		// before thumbnail generation to detect metadata that the JPEG thumbnail pipeline cannot preserve.
43		thumbnailMetadataProbeSize = 1 << 20

45		// maxConcurrentThumbnails limits concurrent thumbnail generation to prevent memory exhaustion.
46		maxConcurrentThumbnails = 3

48		// cacheMaxAge is the max-age value for Cache-Control headers (1 hour).
49		cacheMaxAge = "public, max-age=3600"

100	// FileServerService handles HTTP file serving with proper range request support.
101	type FileServerService struct {
102		Profile       *profile.Profile
103		Store         *store.Store
104		authenticator *auth.Authenticator
105	
106		// thumbnailSemaphore limits concurrent thumbnail generation.
107		thumbnailSemaphore *semaphore.Weighted
108	}

110	// NewFileServerService creates a new file server service.
111	func NewFileServerService(profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store, secret string) *FileServerService {
112		return &FileServerService{
113			Profile:            profile,
114			Store:              store,
115			authenticator:      auth.NewAuthenticator(store, secret),
116			thumbnailSemaphore: semaphore.NewWeighted(maxConcurrentThumbnails),
117		}
118	}

120	// RegisterRoutes registers HTTP file serving routes.
121	func (s *FileServerService) RegisterRoutes(echoServer *echo.Echo) {
122		fileGroup := echoServer.Group("/file")
123		fileGroup.GET("/attachments/:uid/:filename", s.serveAttachmentFile)
124		fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)
125	}

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}
244	
245	// serveStaticFile serves non-streaming files (images, documents, etc.).
246	func (s *FileServerService) serveStaticFile(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string, wantThumbnail bool) error {
247		// Generate thumbnail for supported image types.
248		if wantThumbnail && thumbnailSupportedTypes[attachment.Type] {
249			if thumbnailBlob, err := s.getOrGenerateThumbnail(c.Request().Context(), attachment); err != nil {
250				if !errors.Is(err, errUseOriginalForThumbnail) {
251					slog.Warn("failed to get thumbnail", "error", err)
252				}
253			} else {
254				setSecurityHeaders(c)
255				setMediaHeaders(c, "image/jpeg", attachment.Type)
256				return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, "image/jpeg", thumbnailBlob)
257			}
258		}
259	
260		setSecurityHeaders(c)
261		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
262	
263		// Force download for non-media files to prevent XSS execution.
264		if !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "image/") && contentType != "application/pdf" {
265			c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentDisposition, fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", attachment.Filename))
266		}
267	
268		switch attachment.StorageType {
269		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
270			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
271			if err != nil {
272				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
273			}
274			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
275			return nil
276		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
277			reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
278			if err != nil {
279				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment reader").Wrap(err)
280			}
281			defer reader.Close()
282			return c.Stream(http.StatusOK, contentType, reader)
283		default:
284			return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, contentType, attachment.Blob)
285		}
286	}

292	// getAttachmentBlob retrieves the binary content of an attachment from storage.
293	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentBlob(attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
294		switch attachment.StorageType {
295		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
296			return s.readLocalFile(attachment.Reference)
297	
298		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
299			return s.downloadFromS3(context.Background(), attachment)
300	
301		default:
302			return attachment.Blob, nil
303		}
304	}
305	
306	// getAttachmentReader returns a reader for streaming attachment content.
307	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentReader(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
308		switch attachment.StorageType {
309		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
310			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
311			if err != nil {
312				return nil, err
313			}
314			file, err := os.Open(filePath)
315			if err != nil {
316				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
317					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
318				}
319				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
320			}
321			return file, nil
322	
323		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
324			s3Client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
325			if err != nil {
326				return nil, err
327			}
328			reader, err := s3Client.GetObjectStream(ctx, s3Object.Key)
329			if err != nil {
330				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to stream from S3")
331			}
332			return reader, nil
333	
334		default:
335			return io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob)), nil
336		}
337	}

339	// resolveLocalPath converts a storage reference to an absolute file path.
340	func (s *FileServerService) resolveLocalPath(reference string) (string, error) {
341		filePath := filepath.FromSlash(reference)
342		if !filepath.IsAbs(filePath) {
343			filePath = filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, filePath)
344		}
345		return filePath, nil
346	}

348	// readLocalFile reads the entire contents of a local file.
349	func (s *FileServerService) readLocalFile(reference string) ([]byte, error) {
350		filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(reference)
351		if err != nil {
352			return nil, err
353		}
354	
355		file, err := os.Open(filePath)
356		if err != nil {
357			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
358				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
359			}
360			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
361		}
362		defer file.Close()
363	
364		blob, err := io.ReadAll(file)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read file")
367		}
368		return blob, nil
369	}

371	// createS3Client creates an S3 client from attachment payload.
372	func (*FileServerService) createS3Client(attachment *store.Attachment) (*s3.Client, *storepb.AttachmentPayload_S3Object, error) {
373		if attachment.Payload == nil {
374			return nil, nil, errors.New("attachment payload is missing")
375		}
376		s3Object := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
377		if s3Object == nil {
378			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object payload is missing")
379		}
380		if s3Object.S3Config == nil {
381			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 config is missing")
382		}
383		if s3Object.Key == "" {
384			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object key is missing")
385		}
386	
387		client, err := s3.NewClient(context.Background(), s3Object.S3Config)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create S3 client")
390		}
391		return client, s3Object, nil
392	}

394	// downloadFromS3 downloads the entire object from S3.
395	func (s *FileServerService) downloadFromS3(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
396		client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		blob, err := client.GetObject(ctx, s3Object.Key)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to download from S3")
404		}
405		return blob, nil
406	}

426	// getOrGenerateThumbnail returns the thumbnail image of the attachment.
427	// Uses semaphore to limit concurrent thumbnail generation and prevent memory exhaustion.
428	func (s *FileServerService) getOrGenerateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
429		thumbnailPath, err := s.getThumbnailPath(attachment)
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, err
432		}
433	
434		// Fast path: return cached thumbnail if exists.
435		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
436			return blob, nil
437		}
438	
439		useOriginal, err := s.shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx, attachment)
440		if err != nil {
441			return nil, err
442		}
443		if useOriginal {
444			return nil, errUseOriginalForThumbnail
445		}
446	
447		// Acquire semaphore to limit concurrent generation.
448		if err := s.thumbnailSemaphore.Acquire(ctx, 1); err != nil {
449			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to acquire semaphore")
450		}
451		defer s.thumbnailSemaphore.Release(1)
452	
453		// Double-check after acquiring semaphore (another goroutine may have generated it).
454		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
455			return blob, nil
456		}
457	
458		return s.generateThumbnail(ctx, attachment, thumbnailPath)
459	}
460	
461	// getThumbnailPath returns the file path for a cached thumbnail.
462	func (s *FileServerService) getThumbnailPath(attachment *store.Attachment) (string, error) {
463		cacheFolder := filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, ThumbnailCacheFolder)
464		if err := os.MkdirAll(cacheFolder, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
465			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail cache folder")
466		}
467		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%s.v2.jpeg", attachment.UID)
468		return filepath.Join(cacheFolder, filename), nil
469	}

471	func (s *FileServerService) shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (bool, error) {
472		if attachment.Type == "image/heic" || attachment.Type == "image/heif" {
473			return true, nil
474		}
475	
476		if attachment.Type != "image/jpeg" && attachment.Type != "image/jpg" && attachment.Type != "image/png" && attachment.Type != "image/webp" {
477			return false, nil
478		}
479	
480		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
481		if err != nil {
482			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open image for metadata probe")
483		}
484		defer reader.Close()
485	
486		probe, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, thumbnailMetadataProbeSize))
487		if err != nil {
488			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read image metadata probe")
489		}
490	
491		return hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(attachment.Type, probe), nil
492	}
493	
494	func hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(mimeType string, data []byte) bool {
495		if mimeType == "image/heic" || mimeType == "image/heif" {
496			return true
497		}
498	
499		for _, marker := range [][]byte{
500			[]byte("ICC_PROFILE"),
501			[]byte("iCCP"),
502			[]byte("ICCP"),
503			[]byte("cICP"),
504			[]byte("mDCv"),
505			[]byte("cLLi"),
506		} {
507			if bytes.Contains(data, marker) {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511	
512		lowerData := strings.ToLower(string(data))
513		for _, marker := range []string{
514			"hdrgm:",
515			"hdr gain map",
516			"hdrgainmap",
517			"gainmap",
518			"ultrahdr",
519			"adobe:hdrgainmap",
520			"aux:hdr",
521			"auxiliaryimagetype",
522			"display p3",
523			"display-p3",
524			"rec.2020",
525			"bt.2020",
526			"arib-std-b67",
527			"smpte st 2084",
528		} {
529			if strings.Contains(lowerData, marker) {
530				return true
531			}
532		}
533	
534		return false
535	}

537	// readCachedThumbnail reads a thumbnail from the cache directory.
538	func (*FileServerService) readCachedThumbnail(path string) ([]byte, error) {
539		file, err := os.Open(path)
540		if err != nil {
541			return nil, err
542		}
543		defer file.Close()
544		return io.ReadAll(file)
545	}

547	// generateThumbnail creates a new thumbnail and saves it to disk.
548	func (s *FileServerService) generateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, thumbnailPath string) ([]byte, error) {
549		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get attachment reader")
552		}
553		defer reader.Close()
554	
555		img, err := imaging.Decode(reader, imaging.AutoOrientation(true))
556		if err != nil {
557			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to decode image")
558		}
559	
560		width, height := img.Bounds().Dx(), img.Bounds().Dy()
561		thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight := calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height)
562	
563		thumbnailImage := imaging.Resize(img, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight, imaging.Lanczos)
564	
565		output, err := os.Create(thumbnailPath)
566		if err != nil {
567			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail file")
568		}
569		defer output.Close()
570	
571		if err := imaging.Encode(output, thumbnailImage, imaging.JPEG, imaging.JPEGQuality(90)); err != nil {
572			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to save thumbnail")
573		}
574	
575		return s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath)
576	}
577	
578	// calculateThumbnailDimensions calculates the target dimensions for a thumbnail.
579	// The largest dimension is constrained to thumbnailMaxSize while maintaining aspect ratio.
580	// Small images are not enlarged.
581	func calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height int) (int, int) {
582		if max(width, height) <= thumbnailMaxSize {
583			return width, height
584		}
585		if width >= height {
586			return thumbnailMaxSize, 0 // Landscape: constrain width.
587		}
588		return 0, thumbnailMaxSize // Portrait: constrain height.
589	}

591	func (s *FileServerService) serveMotionClip(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
592		motionMedia := attachment.Payload.GetMotionMedia()
593		if motionMedia == nil || motionMedia.Family != storepb.MotionMediaFamily_ANDROID_MOTION_PHOTO || !motionMedia.HasEmbeddedVideo {
594			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "attachment does not have motion clip")
595		}
596	
597		clipBlob, err := s.getOrExtractMotionClip(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
598		if err != nil {
599			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get motion clip").Wrap(err)
600		}
601	
602		setSecurityHeaders(c)
603		setMediaHeaders(c, "video/mp4", "video/mp4")
604		modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
605		http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.UID+".mp4", modTime, bytes.NewReader(clipBlob))
606		return nil
607	}
608	
609	func (s *FileServerService) getOrExtractMotionClip(_ context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
610		motionPath, err := s.getMotionPath(attachment)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614	
615		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(motionPath); err == nil {
616			return blob, nil
617		}
618	
619		blob, err := s.getAttachmentBlob(attachment)
620		if err != nil {
621			return nil, err
622		}
623	
624		videoBlob, _ := motionphoto.ExtractVideo(blob)
625		if len(videoBlob) == 0 {
626			return nil, errors.New("motion video not found")
627		}
628

649	// checkAttachmentPermission verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
650	func (s *FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
651		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
652		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
653			user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
654			if err != nil {
655				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
656			}
657			if user == nil {
658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {
687				return nil
688			}
689		}
690	
691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
700			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
701		}
702	
703		return nil
704	}

386	func testPNGWithChunk(t *testing.T, chunkType string, chunkData []byte) []byte {
387		t.Helper()
388	
389		img := image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 1, 1))
390		img.Set(0, 0, color.RGBA{R: 255, A: 255})
391	
392		var encoded bytes.Buffer
393		require.NoError(t, png.Encode(&encoded, img))
394	
395		pngData := encoded.Bytes()
396		iendIndex := bytes.LastIndex(pngData, []byte("IEND"))
397		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, iendIndex, 4)
398	
399		chunkStart := iendIndex - 4
400		var chunk bytes.Buffer
401		require.NoError(t, binary.Write(&chunk, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(chunkData))))
402		chunk.WriteString(chunkType)
403		chunk.Write(chunkData)
404		checksum := crc32.ChecksumIEEE(append([]byte(chunkType), chunkData...))
405		require.NoError(t, binary.Write(&chunk, binary.BigEndian, checksum))
406	
407		result := make([]byte, 0, len(pngData)+chunk.Len())
408		result = append(result, pngData[:chunkStart]...)
409		result = append(result, chunk.Bytes()...)
410		result = append(result, pngData[chunkStart:]...)
411		return result
412	}

113			Profile:            profile,
114			Store:              store,

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

167	// serveUserAvatar serves user avatar images.
168	func (s *FileServerService) serveUserAvatar(c *echo.Context) error {
169		ctx := c.Request().Context()
170	
171		// On a private instance (no InstanceURL), avatars are not exposed to anonymous
172		// visitors; a valid session, access token, or PAT is required.
173		if !s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
174			viewer, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
175			if err != nil {
176				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
177			}
178			if viewer == nil {
179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
180			}
181		}
182	
183		identifier := c.Param("identifier")
184	
185		user, err := s.getUserByUsername(ctx, identifier)
186		if err != nil {
187			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get user").Wrap(err)
188		}
189		if user == nil {
190			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "user not found")
191		}
192		if user.AvatarURL == "" {
193			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "avatar not found")
194		}
195	
196		imageType, imageData, err := s.parseDataURI(user.AvatarURL)
197		if err != nil {
198			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to parse avatar data").Wrap(err)
199		}
200	
201		if !avatarAllowedTypes[imageType] {
202			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid avatar image type")
203		}
204	
205		setSecurityHeaders(c)
206		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentType, imageType)
207		c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderCacheControl, cacheMaxAge)
208	
209		return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, imageType, imageData)
210	}

216	// serveMediaStream serves video/audio files using streaming to avoid memory exhaustion.
217	func (s *FileServerService) serveMediaStream(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string) error {
218		setSecurityHeaders(c)
219		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
220	
221		switch attachment.StorageType {
222		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
223			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
224			if err != nil {
225				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
226			}
227			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
228			return nil
229	
230		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
231			presignURL, err := s.getS3PresignedURL(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
232			if err != nil {
233				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to generate presigned URL").Wrap(err)
234			}
235			return c.Redirect(http.StatusTemporaryRedirect, presignURL)
236	
237		default:
238			// Database storage fallback.
239			modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
240			http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.Filename, modTime, bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob))
241			return nil
242		}
243	}
244	
245	// serveStaticFile serves non-streaming files (images, documents, etc.).
246	func (s *FileServerService) serveStaticFile(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, contentType string, wantThumbnail bool) error {
247		// Generate thumbnail for supported image types.
248		if wantThumbnail && thumbnailSupportedTypes[attachment.Type] {
249			if thumbnailBlob, err := s.getOrGenerateThumbnail(c.Request().Context(), attachment); err != nil {
250				if !errors.Is(err, errUseOriginalForThumbnail) {
251					slog.Warn("failed to get thumbnail", "error", err)
252				}
253			} else {
254				setSecurityHeaders(c)
255				setMediaHeaders(c, "image/jpeg", attachment.Type)
256				return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, "image/jpeg", thumbnailBlob)
257			}
258		}
259	
260		setSecurityHeaders(c)
261		setMediaHeaders(c, contentType, attachment.Type)
262	
263		// Force download for non-media files to prevent XSS execution.
264		if !strings.HasPrefix(contentType, "image/") && contentType != "application/pdf" {
265			c.Response().Header().Set(echo.HeaderContentDisposition, fmt.Sprintf("attachment; filename=%q", attachment.Filename))
266		}
267	
268		switch attachment.StorageType {
269		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
270			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
271			if err != nil {
272				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to resolve file path").Wrap(err)
273			}
274			http.ServeFile(c.Response(), c.Request(), filePath)
275			return nil
276		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
277			reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
278			if err != nil {
279				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment reader").Wrap(err)
280			}
281			defer reader.Close()
282			return c.Stream(http.StatusOK, contentType, reader)
283		default:
284			return c.Blob(http.StatusOK, contentType, attachment.Blob)
285		}
286	}

292	// getAttachmentBlob retrieves the binary content of an attachment from storage.
293	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentBlob(attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
294		switch attachment.StorageType {
295		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
296			return s.readLocalFile(attachment.Reference)
297	
298		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
299			return s.downloadFromS3(context.Background(), attachment)
300	
301		default:
302			return attachment.Blob, nil
303		}
304	}

306	// getAttachmentReader returns a reader for streaming attachment content.
307	func (s *FileServerService) getAttachmentReader(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
308		switch attachment.StorageType {
309		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_LOCAL:
310			filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(attachment.Reference)
311			if err != nil {
312				return nil, err
313			}
314			file, err := os.Open(filePath)
315			if err != nil {
316				if os.IsNotExist(err) {
317					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
318				}
319				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
320			}
321			return file, nil
322	
323		case storepb.AttachmentStorageType_S3:
324			s3Client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
325			if err != nil {
326				return nil, err
327			}
328			reader, err := s3Client.GetObjectStream(ctx, s3Object.Key)
329			if err != nil {
330				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to stream from S3")
331			}
332			return reader, nil
333	
334		default:
335			return io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(attachment.Blob)), nil
336		}
337	}

339	// resolveLocalPath converts a storage reference to an absolute file path.
340	func (s *FileServerService) resolveLocalPath(reference string) (string, error) {
341		filePath := filepath.FromSlash(reference)
342		if !filepath.IsAbs(filePath) {
343			filePath = filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, filePath)
344		}
345		return filePath, nil
346	}

348	// readLocalFile reads the entire contents of a local file.
349	func (s *FileServerService) readLocalFile(reference string) ([]byte, error) {
350		filePath, err := s.resolveLocalPath(reference)
351		if err != nil {
352			return nil, err
353		}
354	
355		file, err := os.Open(filePath)
356		if err != nil {
357			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
358				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "file not found")
359			}
360			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open file")
361		}
362		defer file.Close()
363	
364		blob, err := io.ReadAll(file)
365		if err != nil {
366			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read file")
367		}
368		return blob, nil
369	}

371	// createS3Client creates an S3 client from attachment payload.
372	func (*FileServerService) createS3Client(attachment *store.Attachment) (*s3.Client, *storepb.AttachmentPayload_S3Object, error) {
373		if attachment.Payload == nil {
374			return nil, nil, errors.New("attachment payload is missing")
375		}
376		s3Object := attachment.Payload.GetS3Object()
377		if s3Object == nil {
378			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object payload is missing")
379		}
380		if s3Object.S3Config == nil {
381			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 config is missing")
382		}
383		if s3Object.Key == "" {
384			return nil, nil, errors.New("S3 object key is missing")
385		}
386	
387		client, err := s3.NewClient(context.Background(), s3Object.S3Config)
388		if err != nil {
389			return nil, nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create S3 client")
390		}
391		return client, s3Object, nil
392	}

394	// downloadFromS3 downloads the entire object from S3.
395	func (s *FileServerService) downloadFromS3(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
396		client, s3Object, err := s.createS3Client(attachment)
397		if err != nil {
398			return nil, err
399		}
400	
401		blob, err := client.GetObject(ctx, s3Object.Key)
402		if err != nil {
403			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to download from S3")
404		}
405		return blob, nil
406	}

408	// getS3PresignedURL generates a presigned URL for direct S3 access.
409	func (s *FileServerService) getS3PresignedURL(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (string, error) {

413		}

415		url, err := client.PresignGetObject(ctx, s3Object.Key)
416		if err != nil {
417			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to presign URL")
418		}
419		return url, nil

423	// Thumbnail Generation
424	// =============================================================================
425	
426	// getOrGenerateThumbnail returns the thumbnail image of the attachment.
427	// Uses semaphore to limit concurrent thumbnail generation and prevent memory exhaustion.
428	func (s *FileServerService) getOrGenerateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
429		thumbnailPath, err := s.getThumbnailPath(attachment)
430		if err != nil {
431			return nil, err
432		}
433	
434		// Fast path: return cached thumbnail if exists.
435		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
436			return blob, nil
437		}
438	
439		useOriginal, err := s.shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx, attachment)
440		if err != nil {
441			return nil, err
442		}
443		if useOriginal {
444			return nil, errUseOriginalForThumbnail
445		}
446	
447		// Acquire semaphore to limit concurrent generation.
448		if err := s.thumbnailSemaphore.Acquire(ctx, 1); err != nil {
449			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to acquire semaphore")
450		}
451		defer s.thumbnailSemaphore.Release(1)
452	
453		// Double-check after acquiring semaphore (another goroutine may have generated it).
454		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath); err == nil {
455			return blob, nil
456		}
457	
458		return s.generateThumbnail(ctx, attachment, thumbnailPath)
459	}
460	
461	// getThumbnailPath returns the file path for a cached thumbnail.
462	func (s *FileServerService) getThumbnailPath(attachment *store.Attachment) (string, error) {
463		cacheFolder := filepath.Join(s.Profile.Data, ThumbnailCacheFolder)
464		if err := os.MkdirAll(cacheFolder, os.ModePerm); err != nil {
465			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail cache folder")
466		}
467		filename := fmt.Sprintf("%s.v2.jpeg", attachment.UID)
468		return filepath.Join(cacheFolder, filename), nil
469	}

471	func (s *FileServerService) shouldUseOriginalForThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) (bool, error) {
472		if attachment.Type == "image/heic" || attachment.Type == "image/heif" {
473			return true, nil
474		}
475	
476		if attachment.Type != "image/jpeg" && attachment.Type != "image/jpg" && attachment.Type != "image/png" && attachment.Type != "image/webp" {
477			return false, nil
478		}
479	
480		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
481		if err != nil {
482			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to open image for metadata probe")
483		}
484		defer reader.Close()
485	
486		probe, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, thumbnailMetadataProbeSize))
487		if err != nil {
488			return false, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to read image metadata probe")
489		}
490	
491		return hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(attachment.Type, probe), nil
492	}
493	
494	func hasThumbnailSensitiveMetadata(mimeType string, data []byte) bool {
495		if mimeType == "image/heic" || mimeType == "image/heif" {
496			return true
497		}
498	
499		for _, marker := range [][]byte{
500			[]byte("ICC_PROFILE"),
501			[]byte("iCCP"),
502			[]byte("ICCP"),
503			[]byte("cICP"),
504			[]byte("mDCv"),
505			[]byte("cLLi"),
506		} {
507			if bytes.Contains(data, marker) {
508				return true
509			}
510		}
511	
512		lowerData := strings.ToLower(string(data))
513		for _, marker := range []string{
514			"hdrgm:",
515			"hdr gain map",
516			"hdrgainmap",
517			"gainmap",
518			"ultrahdr",
519			"adobe:hdrgainmap",
520			"aux:hdr",
521			"auxiliaryimagetype",
522			"display p3",
523			"display-p3",
524			"rec.2020",
525			"bt.2020",
526			"arib-std-b67",
527			"smpte st 2084",
528		} {
529			if strings.Contains(lowerData, marker) {
530				return true
531			}
532		}
533	
534		return false
535	}

537	// readCachedThumbnail reads a thumbnail from the cache directory.
538	func (*FileServerService) readCachedThumbnail(path string) ([]byte, error) {
539		file, err := os.Open(path)
540		if err != nil {
541			return nil, err
542		}
543		defer file.Close()
544		return io.ReadAll(file)
545	}

547	// generateThumbnail creates a new thumbnail and saves it to disk.
548	func (s *FileServerService) generateThumbnail(ctx context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment, thumbnailPath string) ([]byte, error) {
549		reader, err := s.getAttachmentReader(ctx, attachment)
550		if err != nil {
551			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get attachment reader")
552		}
553		defer reader.Close()
554	
555		img, err := imaging.Decode(reader, imaging.AutoOrientation(true))
556		if err != nil {
557			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to decode image")
558		}
559	
560		width, height := img.Bounds().Dx(), img.Bounds().Dy()
561		thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight := calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height)
562	
563		thumbnailImage := imaging.Resize(img, thumbnailWidth, thumbnailHeight, imaging.Lanczos)
564	
565		output, err := os.Create(thumbnailPath)
566		if err != nil {
567			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create thumbnail file")
568		}
569		defer output.Close()
570	
571		if err := imaging.Encode(output, thumbnailImage, imaging.JPEG, imaging.JPEGQuality(90)); err != nil {
572			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to save thumbnail")
573		}
574	
575		return s.readCachedThumbnail(thumbnailPath)
576	}
577	
578	// calculateThumbnailDimensions calculates the target dimensions for a thumbnail.
579	// The largest dimension is constrained to thumbnailMaxSize while maintaining aspect ratio.
580	// Small images are not enlarged.
581	func calculateThumbnailDimensions(width, height int) (int, int) {
582		if max(width, height) <= thumbnailMaxSize {
583			return width, height
584		}
585		if width >= height {
586			return thumbnailMaxSize, 0 // Landscape: constrain width.
587		}
588		return 0, thumbnailMaxSize // Portrait: constrain height.
589	}

591	func (s *FileServerService) serveMotionClip(c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
592		motionMedia := attachment.Payload.GetMotionMedia()
593		if motionMedia == nil || motionMedia.Family != storepb.MotionMediaFamily_ANDROID_MOTION_PHOTO || !motionMedia.HasEmbeddedVideo {
594			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusBadRequest, "attachment does not have motion clip")
595		}
596	
597		clipBlob, err := s.getOrExtractMotionClip(c.Request().Context(), attachment)
598		if err != nil {
599			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get motion clip").Wrap(err)
600		}
601	
602		setSecurityHeaders(c)
603		setMediaHeaders(c, "video/mp4", "video/mp4")
604		modTime := time.Unix(attachment.UpdatedTs, 0)
605		http.ServeContent(c.Response(), c.Request(), attachment.UID+".mp4", modTime, bytes.NewReader(clipBlob))
606		return nil
607	}

609	func (s *FileServerService) getOrExtractMotionClip(_ context.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) ([]byte, error) {
610		motionPath, err := s.getMotionPath(attachment)
611		if err != nil {
612			return nil, err
613		}
614	
615		if blob, err := s.readCachedThumbnail(motionPath); err == nil {
616			return blob, nil
617		}
618	
619		blob, err := s.getAttachmentBlob(attachment)
620		if err != nil {
621			return nil, err
622		}
623	
624		videoBlob, _ := motionphoto.ExtractVideo(blob)
625		if len(videoBlob) == 0 {
626			return nil, errors.New("motion video not found")
627		}
628	
629		if err := os.WriteFile(motionPath, videoBlob, 0644); err != nil {
630			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to cache motion clip")
631		}
632	
633		return videoBlob, nil
634	}

639			return "", errors.Wrap(err, "failed to create motion cache folder")
640		}

642		return filepath.Join(cacheFolder, attachment.UID+".mp4"), nil

645	// =============================================================================
646	// Authentication & Authorization
647	// =============================================================================
648	
649	// checkAttachmentPermission verifies the user has permission to access the attachment.
650	func (s *FileServerService) checkAttachmentPermission(ctx context.Context, c *echo.Context, attachment *store.Attachment) error {
651		// For unlinked attachments, only the creator can access.
652		if attachment.MemoID == nil {
653			user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
654			if err != nil {
655				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
656			}
657			if user == nil {
658				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
659			}
660			if user.ID != attachment.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
661				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
662			}
663			return nil
664		}
665	
666		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{ID: attachment.MemoID})
667		if err != nil {
668			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to find memo").Wrap(err)
669		}
670		if memo == nil {
671			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "memo not found")
672		}
673	
674		// Public-visibility attachments are served to anonymous visitors only when the
675		// instance allows anonymous access. On a private instance (no InstanceURL), the
676		// request must still resolve to an authenticated user or a valid share token below.
677		if memo.Visibility == store.Public && s.Profile.AllowAnonymous() {
678			return nil
679		}
680	
681		// Check share token fallback: allow access if request carries a valid, non-expired share token
682		// that was issued for this specific memo. This covers attachment requests made from the shared
683		// memo page for private or protected memos.
684		if shareToken := (*c).QueryParam("share_token"); shareToken != "" {
685			ms, err := s.Store.GetMemoShare(ctx, &store.FindMemoShare{UID: &shareToken})
686			if err == nil && ms != nil && !isMemoShareExpired(ms) && ms.MemoID == memo.ID {
687				return nil
688			}
689		}
690	
691		user, err := s.getCurrentUser(ctx, c)
692		if err != nil {
693			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get current user").Wrap(err)
694		}
695		if user == nil {
696			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")
697		}
698	
699		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && user.ID != memo.CreatorID && user.Role != store.RoleAdmin {
700			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusForbidden, "forbidden access")
701		}
702	
703		return nil
704	}
705

707	// Authentication priority: Bearer token (Access Token V2 or PAT) > Refresh token cookie.

176			}

181		setting := &v1pb.UserSetting{
182			Name: fmt.Sprintf("%s/settings/%s", BuildUserName(user.Username), settingKey),

185		switch storeSetting.Key {

386	func testPNGWithChunk(t *testing.T, chunkType string, chunkData []byte) []byte {
387		t.Helper()
388	
389		img := image.NewRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, 1, 1))
390		img.Set(0, 0, color.RGBA{R: 255, A: 255})
391	
392		var encoded bytes.Buffer
393		require.NoError(t, png.Encode(&encoded, img))
394	
395		pngData := encoded.Bytes()
396		iendIndex := bytes.LastIndex(pngData, []byte("IEND"))
397		require.GreaterOrEqual(t, iendIndex, 4)
398	
399		chunkStart := iendIndex - 4
400		var chunk bytes.Buffer
401		require.NoError(t, binary.Write(&chunk, binary.BigEndian, uint32(len(chunkData))))
402		chunk.WriteString(chunkType)
403		chunk.Write(chunkData)
404		checksum := crc32.ChecksumIEEE(append([]byte(chunkType), chunkData...))
405		require.NoError(t, binary.Write(&chunk, binary.BigEndian, checksum))
406	
407		result := make([]byte, 0, len(pngData)+chunk.Len())
408		result = append(result, pngData[:chunkStart]...)
409		result = append(result, chunk.Bytes()...)
410		result = append(result, pngData[chunkStart:]...)
411		return result
412	}
